verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's storage is S3-compatible and its infra is managed via standard Kubernetes/Terraform rather than proprietary formats, which implies portability, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk data-export tool or account-closure/data-exit process for users to formally 'take their data and leave.' missing for 10: explicit data export/migration tooling, documentation of full data portability guarantees, and confirmation that all data types (not just object storage) can be exported in open formats.
